data_note: Public dashboard tracking begins on Opening Night, March 25, 2026. Trained on 2024 and 2025 season data.

tier_guide.label: elite
tier_guide.description: Most selective subset on the board. Current production policy starts at the top 99% of each slate.

tier_guide.label: strong
tier_guide.description: Main public board after the elite subset is carved out.

tier_guide.label: watch
tier_guide.description: Worth monitoring, but lower-confidence than the main public board.

tier_guide.label: longshot
tier_guide.description: Visible only when all tiers are enabled.

runs.label: Prepare
runs.description: Runs once after 6:00 AM ET, refreshes data, retrains the model for the day, settles any remaining prior results, and saves the fixed morning baseline slate.

runs.time_et: Every 5 minutes until last first pitch
runs.label: Mixed refresh
runs.description: Keeps the morning board fixed while updating statuses and annotating only major alerts such as scratches or severe weather.

runs.label: Settle
runs.description: Checks today's board from first pitch through final, updates each entry in place, and archives the whole slate only after every tracked game is complete.

ballparkpal_explainer.title: Ballpark Pal weights
ballparkpal_explainer.summary: Ballpark Pal XX.X is the slate-normalized Batter HomeRunProbability score on a 0-100 scale. 50.0 is neutral; above 50.0 is favorable and below 50.0 is unfavorable. The Today slider defaults to a 10/90 Ballpark Pal/model blend and can re-rank the live board.
ballparkpal_explainer.score_note: Ballpark Pal XX.X is the slate-normalized Batter.HomeRunProbability score in the HR Chance cell.
ballparkpal_explainer.blend_note: Use the Today slider to reweight the live board from 0% to 100% Ballpark Pal against the model.
ballparkpal_explainer.ranking_note: Confidence tiers are derived from the blended score percentile on the slate.
